messages:
Aisha: Morning team — quick status. We have ~48 trial/onboard tenants reporting slow embeddings and delayed ingests since 02:15 UTC. Product has labeled this a degradation related to the new batching switch.
Marco: Got it. Any immediate risk to renewals? Which tiers/hot accounts?
Aisha: ~12 high-touch (enterprise trials), 20 mid-market, rest SMB. Renewal risk concentrated in the 12 — they’re in activation windows.
Priya: Do we have a temporary workaround we can offer customers while SRE fixes the root cause?
Dan: Yes — we can route affected embedding traffic to the dedicated embedding pool (warm nodes) as a fallback. Latency will be higher cost but stable. I can flip the route for those 12 accounts now if CS approves.
Aisha: That's the play I was thinking. Proposal: immediate routing for the 12 high-touch accounts + a targeted credit offer for impacted usage during the window + invite to a prioritized onboarding office hours session.
Elena: Legal needs the credit language to avoid implying SLA admission. Suggest: "We’re offering a one-time account credit as a gesture of goodwill while we investigate" and avoid specific blame.
Marco: How big should the credit be? Standard is 10% for general issues; for activation risks we usually do 20-30% or $X credit minimum.
Priya: For the communication, we should include a short technical explanation, the workaround steps (what we did on their behalf), and a link to book onboarding office hours. I'll draft localized fragments (EN, FR, DE) after we lock wording.
Aisha: Draft outreach (short):

Hi <Customer>,

We wanted to let you know we saw an intermittent slowdown affecting embeddings ingestion earlier today. We've routed your embedding requests to a stable fallback pool and are monitoring performance now. As a gesture, we’ll apply a one-time credit to your account and offer priority office hours to complete onboarding.

If you’d like us to walk through your ingest pipeline live, book here: <booking link>.

— Aisha, Customer Success

Aisha: @Dan can you confirm routing completed and any expected ETA on full rollback?
Dan: Routing kicked in at 03:02 UTC for the 12 accounts. Monitoring graphs show decreased error/latency within 7 minutes. Root cause analysis ongoing — ETA for full patch 6–8 hours, but I’ll update if it’s sooner.
OpsBot: Incident #INC-2024-1123 created: https://redwood.incidents/INC-2024-1123 — state: investigating. (auto)
Marco: OK. Action items: (1) Apply routing for 12 accounts (done), (2) Prepare credit proposal for leadership (Proposed: 25% credit for impacted billing period or $500 min), (3) Send outreach draft and localized copy, (4) Schedule office hours slots this afternoon and reserve 2 engineers.
Priya: I’ll prepare EN/FR/DE drafts and a short FAQ snippet answering "what happened" and "what we did". ETA 45m.
Elena: Sign-off on outreach wording once credit amount is nailed — copy must include how to escalate and how credits are applied.
Aisha: I'll coordinate comms and speaker for office hours. Will ping sales for any exec-escale customers. Thank you all — I’ll post the final send & list of customers once we lock credit amount. :thumbsup:
Marco: Thx. Please add the per-tenant routing confirmation IDs to the incident so CS can reference in emails.
Aisha: Adding now. Will follow up with a short template for reply-chain responses to inbound customer question types.
